name: financial-services
one_liner: A ready-made set of AI helpers for finance jobs — drafting pitch decks, checking earnings, reconciling books — that a finance team installs and starts using right away.
buyer: The head of a boutique investment bank or small private equity shop who wants analyst-style grunt work (comps, memos, reconciliations) done faster without hiring more analysts.
business_use_cases: A boutique M&A shop uses the Pitch Agent to turn comps and an LBO model into a client-ready deck overnight instead of an analyst pulling an all-nighter.
A small private equity fund's back office runs the GL Reconciler every month-end to catch reconciliation breaks before the controller reviews them.
A wealth management office runs the Meeting Prep Agent each morning so every advisor walks into client meetings with a fresh briefing pack.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid onboarding service that tunes these agents to a firm's templates and compliance rules.
Build a specialized add-on agent for a filing type this pack doesn't cover (e.g. Form ADV, Reg BI) and license it to compliance teams.

steal_this: Install the Market Researcher agent, point it at an under-covered micro-cap sector, and sell the resulting research notes as a paid newsletter to independent investors this weekend.
